messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — starting a targeted entitlement cleanup sweep this week for a44/infra-admin-ish roles. Goal: remove long-lived admin bindings and validate KMS grants. Hoping to keep changes low-risk; planning a canary + 48h rollback window.
jon: 👍 can you paste the runbook link and scope?
maya: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privilege-sweep (read-only for now). Scope: any principal with role:admin-like that hasn't been active in 90d OR is ownerless. Also cross-check svcacct keys that have KMS grants.
lee: for KMS checks I'll run the query against keystore audit logs — we'll look for CreateCryptoKeyVersion / AsymmetricSign from non-owner principals. 
olga: do we have a list of current owner tags? last time a lot of roles were 'team:unknown' so tickets stalled.
maya: good call. @sam can you export owner map from the entitlement service? format: csv with principal, role, last_auth_ts.
sam: on it. exporting now, will drop to #eng-security-temp. ETA 20m.
security-bot: [audit] export triggered by sam at 2026-03-21T15:08:10Z. File: s3://redwood-audit-exports/5487654321/ownermap.csv
jon: question: if a service account is ownerless but has a KMS binding, do we auto-revoke or just open a ticket?
lee: prefer open ticket + temp-disable if usage pattern is suspicious. Auto-revoke is risky for oncall. We can add a throttle: if key hasn't been used in 180d AND principal has 0 deployments -> revoke.
maya: agree — policy: (last_use>180d AND principal_deploy_count==0) => queued for revoke, ownerless => create JIRA with Security reviewer, 72h to respond, then revoke.
olga: need to coordinate with Prod Infra for KMS IAM changes; they handle key ACL changes for fw teams. I'll ping them.
sam: ownermap uploaded: s3://redwood-audit-exports/5487654321/ownermap.csv (shared with infra and sec).
jon: ps — vuln triage note: yesterday's scanner flagged a control-plane endpoint allowing overly broad role grants via a legacy API. Is that in scope?
maya: yes, include it. If there's an exploitable path to grant admin roles, we treat it as high-severity and pause the sweep on affected services until mitigated. 
lee: here's the quick query I used to find KMS bindings (gcp example):
```
gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=prod --format=json | jq '.[] | select(.bindings[]?.role=="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter")'
```
use equivalent for AWS/Azure keys.
olga: audit log retention question — some deleted principals still show in logs older than 365d. Are we keeping logs that long?
maya: default retention is 400d for high-sensitivity projects, 90d for standard. For entitlements we snapshot ownermap and key grants to s3 with 7yr retention for compliance.
sam: ticket created: SEC-2319 "Q2 entitlement sweep - ownerless KMS grants". Assigned to @olga, reviewers: @jon, @lee.
security-bot: [jira] SEC-2319 created by sam. Priority: P2.
jon: rollback plan detail: any RBAC change must include a revocation token (temporary role id) so we can re-grant. Also capture terraform state before apply and tag commits with sweep/batch id.
maya: noted. We'll enforce: 1) branch per batch 2) state snapshot stored s3://redwood-state/sweeps/5487654321.tfstate 3) revert PR template.
lee: small ops note — when removing a KMS grant, we should run smoke tests for dependent services. I can add a CI job that hits the key usage path.
olga: if a service errors on key removal, we open an incident? or just revert and investigate?
maya: if it's causing production outages -> incident and revert. If it's harmless and only fails noncritical jobs -> file a postmortem ticket. We'll escalate on pager trigger.
sam: uploaded pre-change snapshot and smoke test matrix to the ticket.
jon: I found 12 ownerless svcaccts that match criteria. I'll split into 3 batches by blast radius. Batch names: alpha/bravo/charlie.
maya: alpha = low-risk, bravo = requires infra notice, charlie = requires canary and oncall. We'll run alpha Friday 02:00 PT. Notify slack #eng-oncall 24h in advance.
security-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled run: entitlement-sweep/alpha @ 2026-03-27T02:00:00-08:00.
olga: FYI — PKI team reminded me: removing KMS grants may break certificate rotation for a few services. I've flagged two svcaccts to exclude from alpha.
lee: ack. I'll exclude them from the gcloud revoke script.
maya: final checklist before alpha: ownermap + csv attached to ticket, tfstate snapshot present, smoke tests for each principal, infra notified, rollback PR template ready. Anything else?
sam: add audit-log hook to capture any grant/revoke events within 24h post-change and alert to #eng-security-critical.
maya: good. set alert: any Grant/Revoke on prod keys -> pager to sec oncall.
jon: one more: confirm KMS HSM-backed keys have change window and require PKI owner's thumbprint. We should not auto-remove HSM grants.
olga: confirmed — HSM keys are exempt unless owner signs off.
maya: thanks team. I'll send the alpha notice and create the PR for the batch. Will post a short summary in #general after we complete alpha. :thumbsup:
